blocks.text: Thyroid titli (butterfly) ki shakal ka gland hai jo gardan ke aage trachea (saans ki nali) ke dono taraf hota hai. Yeh do jure hue lobes se bana hai. Yeh neeche diye gaye hormones chhorta hai:

blocks.title: Tidbit: metabolism ka master controller
blocks.text: Thyroid gland ko aksar jism ka "Master Controller of Metabolism" kaha jata hai, kyun ke is ke hormones tay karte hain ke jism ka har cell kitni tezi ya aahistagi se kaam kare.

items: Tetra-iodothyronine (T₄) ya thyroxine, aur tri-iodothyronine (T₃): thyroid T₄ bohat zyada banata hai, jo baad mein T₃ mein badal jata hai; T₃ zyada "active" (faal) aur taqatwar hai. Yeh hormones dil ki dharkan aur saans ki raftar barhate hain, cellular respiration tez karte hain aur jism ka basal metabolic rate (aaram ki halat mein metabolism ki raftar) tay karte hain. Yeh jigar (liver) mein glucose ka tootna (catabolism) aur cholesterol ka banna bhi barhate hain. Bachon mein yeh dhanche (skeleton) ki growth aur dimagh ki nashonuma mein madad dete hain.

Calcitonin hormone: khoon mein calcium ki munasib miqdar qaim rakhne mein hissa leta hai. Jab khoon mein calcium bohat barh jaye to calcitonin calcium ko haddiyon mein jazb karwata hai, aur yun khoon mein calcium kam ho jata hai.

blocks.title: For Information: Graves’ disease
blocks.text: Graves’ disease ek autoimmune bimari hai (jism ka defence system apne hi tissue par hamla karta hai) jo hyperthyroidism paida karti hai; aksar thyroid bhi bara ho jata hai. Is ki alamaat: chirchirapan, muscles ki kamzori, neend ke masail, tez dharkan, garmi bardasht na hona, dast (diarrhoea), wazan ghatna aur pindliyon (shins) ki jild mota hona. Exophthalmia (aankhon ka bahar ubhar aana) bhi ho sakta hai.

items: Thyroid hormones ki kami (hypothyroidism): growth ruk jati hai, susti (lethargy), wazan barhna, qabz, cholesterol zyada, aur dil ki dharkan aur jism ka temperature kam.
Agar hypothyroidism foetus (pait mein bachcha) ya bachpan mein ho to cretinism hota hai: growth ruk jati hai aur zehni pasmandagi (mental retardation) hoti hai.

Shadeed hypothyroidism se ek kam milne wali magar jaan leva pecheedgi, myxoedema, ho sakti hai. Is mein connective tissues mein mucopolysaccharides jama ho jate hain, jis se jild aur tissues soojh kar mote ho jate hain.
Agar hypothyroidism iodine ki kami se ho to goitre hota hai, yani thyroid gland soojh jata hai.
Thyroid hormones ka zyada nikalna (hyperthyroidism): wazan ghat'ta hai, aur blood pressure, dil ki dharkan aur jism ka temperature barh jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Iodine ki kami se goitre kyun ho sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Thyroid hormones (T₄ aur T₃) banane ke liye iodine zaroori hai; un ke naam mein 'iodo' isi liye hai. Iodine kam ho to yeh hormones kam bante hain (hypothyroidism), aur kitab ke mutabiq aisi halat mein thyroid gland soojh jata hai: goitre.

items: Thyroid: gardan mein trachea ke dono taraf, do lobes.
T₄ aur T₃ metabolic rate, dil aur saans ki raftar barhate hain aur bachon mein dhanche aur dimagh ki nashonuma karte hain; calcitonin khoon ka calcium kam karta hai.
Kami: hypothyroidism, cretinism, myxoedema, goitre (iodine ki kami); zyadati: hyperthyroidism (maslan Graves’ disease).
